sources.claim: Melee damage increases no longer scale melee-generated Scorch or Ignition.

implemented: solar_outgoing shares empowering, weapon_surge and perks contribution stages without importing parent payloads or conversions
Weapon credit comes from the first Scorch application; a weapon identity alone cannot grant weapon-buff eligibility
Actual Solar recipients supply radiant_champion from observed entity/type tags for each Scorch tick and each Ignition victim
Existing Surge element/copy/Armor Charge conditions, Radiant family and Rampage weapon scope remain authoritative
Incandescent direct explosion keeps its separate profile; this change concerns Scorch and Ignition

sampling_policy.source_bonuses: Captured with the first Scorch damage snapshots; removal/spending/expiry does not rewrite this generation. Later appliers cannot replace the snapshots.
sampling_policy.recipient: Each actual hit inspects its recipient; Champion-dependent Radiant magnitude is resolved at impact.

remaining: Weapon Stat, permanent New Gear Bonus, activity Solar Surge/Overcharge and complete enemy-rank scalars are not supplied by this adapter
All grenade/super/all-ability scaling providers and weapon/exotic special cases remain incomplete; melee multipliers are not imported
Incandescent rank exemption versus generic Scorch non-boss bonus remains uncalibrated
PvE decay, PvP curve/falloff, world damage conversion, ignition windup and original-game sampling boundaries remain explicit calibration gaps
Production loadout/subclass assembly, HUD and physical-world persistence remain incomplete
